## Checklist

- [ ] Base branch is `develop`
- [ ] Title is a user-facing changelog line
- [ ] One logical change
- [ ] Type label present (`enhancement`, `bug`, `documentation`, `breaking-change`, …)
- [ ] For a release: `<tool>/package.json` version bumped (see `CONTRIBUTING.md`)
